title: Local project instructions do not require a Git commit to be discovered
summary: The owner asked whether the updated working agreement was committed and whether committing and pushing are necessary for it to work. Git showed the AGENTS.md change staged but not committed; HEAD and the local origin/main tracking reference both remained at c052ac31753d7a907c33f8eb7fcad970915b492d. Official OpenAI documentation describes discovering instructions from local project files at the start of a run, independent of committing or pushing. The updated instructions were also supplied directly in this conversation and apply here. Committing records the change in Git history; pushing makes it available to subsequent remote checkouts. Local instruction text does not change host sandbox permissions or approval settings. The attached read-only commit-message snapshot was not accessible at its supplied filesystem path; status was checked directly in Git. No commit or push was performed in response to this status question.

evidence.description: Confirmed the working agreement is staged with seventeen added lines and is not included in HEAD.
Official local instruction discovery and session refresh behavior.

nextSteps: Commit and push the working agreement when requested so it is preserved for future remote checkouts; no upload is required for its local use.
